title: A quickstart fill puts a neutral placeholder in a picture slot no business photo fits and goes to review, instead of failing the build
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run the command in `run`.
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: On WordPress, Joomla and EmDash a slot with no fitting photo keeps its place with an uploaded, read-back placeholder, and the report lists the gap and the placeholder.
Every picture missing fills every slot with placeholders; an unresolved slot still stops the fill before any upload; a resumed fill reuses verified uploads.
Quickstart QA with placeholder gaps ends needs-review with reason quickstart-picture-placeholders/1, never passed and never failed.
evidence: Dev, 23/10/2026: a JA Restaurant WordPress Website Opportunities build planned 47 placements and 28 unfilled slots, then failed with QUICKSTART_PICTURE_COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE; the hand-off answered 409 SITE_FILL_FAILED and the site stayed the untouched template.
fence: The quickstart-first native picture fill and its QA/hand-off gate; picture matching rules and the EmDash/contract engines are unchanged

tests: wordpress: a slot no photo fits keeps its place with a neutral placeholder and goes to review
joomla: a slot no photo fits keeps its place with a neutral placeholder and goes to review
emdash: a slot no photo fits keeps its place with a neutral placeholder and goes to review
every picture missing fills every slot with placeholders instead of failing
an unresolved slot still stops the native picture fill before any upload
a resumed picture fill reuses verified uploads, placeholders included
placeholder gaps end the quickstart QA as needs-review, never passed and never failed
